Q1: Super Saturated hydration only. hydration includes a source account reporting hydration with Super Saturated used jointly with a mask or other products; count that source once, preserve co-use and non-separability, and do not attribute isolated serum efficacy. Exclude hydration about other products alone and generic praise. Describe the stage-specific support and limits; final-stage records may identify added versus initial support. Mask fit and star deductions belong only to the mask.
Q2: Super Saturated texture only. texture_direct means a firsthand use sensation, including a direct comparative sensation versus another named product. Ingredient-explanation uncertainty does not turn firsthand texture into speculation. texture_speculative means an untried Super Saturated comparison or predicted texture, not uncertain explanation of an observed sensation. Retain the comparator, continued-use reason and uncertainty; light/fast-drying versus sticky/shiny/slick can coexist. Keep dose/daytime/skin conditions source-owned; no proven condition resolves disagreement without evidence. Other-product-only textures are excluded from both sets.
Q3: Experiment actions only. buying_stockup includes explicit ordering, buying, completed checkout or stock-up; source-account count is distinct reporting accounts. Distinct product-action assertions count each Experiment focal product plus reported action per source once; repeated descriptions of the same action are not new events, and quantities of tubes are not separate assertions. A multi-product account can contribute several assertions but one source account. Do not infer buying from use, ownership, gift, cart addition, intention, or comparator acquisition. Report cart_readdition, gift_receipt, return_considered, return_completed, replacement_intended, replacement_completed separately. Considered return is not completed return; a forecast that one Experiment product will replace multiple comparator products is one Experiment focal-product replacement assertion, with comparator targets retained in its explanation, not a completed switch. Keep explicit personal reasons attributed.
